title: #LenovoAuthenticationAuthority.v1_0_0

enumDescriptions.LocalOnly: User ID and password are verified by searching the list of users locally configured under local login profiles.
enumDescriptions.LDAPOnly: Users are authenticated via a remote LDAP server
enumDescriptions.LocalFirstThenLDAP: Both methods are selected, this is specified order
enumDescriptions.LDAPFirstThenLocal: Both methods are selected, this is specified order

enumDescriptions.ReadOnly: User has only read-only access, and cannot perform any save, modify, clear, or state affecting operations.
enumDescriptions.UserAccountManagement: User can add /modify/delete users and change the Global Login Setting in the Login Profiles panel.
enumDescriptions.RemoteConsoleAccess: User can access the remote server console and can modify the configuration in the Serical Port panel.
enumDescriptions.RemoteConsoleAndVirtualMediaAcccess: User can access the remote server console and the remote disk functions for the remote server and modify the configuration in the serial Port panel.
enumDescriptions.RemoteServerPowerRestartAccess: User can access the power on, restart and server timeout functions for the remote server.
enumDescriptions.AbilityClearEventLogs: User can clear the event logs. Everyone can look at the event log, but this particular permission is reguired ro clear the logs.
enumDescriptions.AdapterConfiguration_Basic: User can modify configuration parameters about system settings(excluding Contact, Location and Server Timeouts) and Alerts panels.
enumDescriptions.AdapterConfiguration_NetworkingAndSecuri: User can modify the configuration about Security,Network protocols,Network Interface, and Port Assignments panels.
enumDescriptions.AdapterConfiguration_Advanced: User has no restrictions when congiguring the adapter. In addition the user is said to have administrative access to the IMM, meaning that the user can also perform the following advanced functions: firmware upgrades, PXE network boot, restore adapter factory defaults, modify and restore adapter configuration from a configuration file, and restore/reset the adapter. This excludes Server Power/Restore Control and timeout functions.

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.

AuthenticationProtocol.description: Specify the algorithms used by the SNMP V3 security model for the authtication.

PrivacyProtocol.description: Specify the encryption in data transfer between the SNMP client and the agent. The value is valid only if the AuthenticationProtocol is either HMAC-MD5 or HMAC-SHA.

AccessType.description: Specify either GET or SET as the  access type.

Destination.description: Specify the trap destination for the user.
Destination.longDescription: This can be an IP address or hostname.Using traps, SNMP agent notifies the management station about events, like CPU temperature crossing the limit,etc.

SNMPv3Settings.description: This schema defines a resource for user config SNMP V3.
SNMPv3Settings.longDescription: This resource shall be used to represent resources that can config SNMP V3 for each user account taht will need SNMP V3 access.

enumDescriptions.HMAC_MD5: Hash-based Message Authentication Code(HMAC)-Message Digest algorithm 5(MD5)
enumDescriptions.HMAC_SHA: Hash-based Message Authentication Code(HMAC)-Secure Hash Algorithm(SHA).

enumDescriptions.Get: User can only perform query operation
enumDescriptions.Set: User can query and modify the setting

SSHPublicKey.description: Specify the SSH public key of the user in OpenSSH format.
SSHPublicKey.longDescription: The value of this property shall specify the SSH public key of the user in OpenSSH format.
